title: client.state_changed (v2)
description: An OAuth client was suspended, reactivated or decommissioned. Emitted when an administrator changes a client's state. Suspension and decommissioning revoke the client's refresh families, grants and opaque access tokens; decommissioning also revokes its credentials and is final. Emitted by every successful call, even when the state is unchanged. org_id is never set.

data.description: Event data. Both payload forms carry every listed member (client_ref is kept in the minimal form).

client_ref.description: The client's internal reference (cli_...), not its OAuth client_id.

organization_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.
